---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

```{r}
data("billboard", package = "tidyr")

# Reshape the dataset
billboard_long <- billboard %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("wk"), 
               names_to = "week", 
               values_to = "rank", 
               values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(week = as.integer(gsub("wk", "", week)))


# Pick top 5 songs with the most weeks on chart
top_songs <- billboard_long %>%
  group_by(track) %>%
  summarise(weeks_on_chart = n()) %>%
  top_n(5, weeks_on_chart)

# Filter dataset to include only top songs
plot_data <- billboard_long %>%
  filter(track %in% top_songs$track)

# Create the plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +  # Because rank 1 is better than 100
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(plot_data$week), 5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Chart Performance Over Time",
    subtitle = "Top 5 longest-charting songs from the tidyr::billboard dataset",
    x = "Week on Chart",
    y = "Billboard Rank",
    color = "Song Title"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10))
  ) +
  ggthemes::scale_color_tableau()

```
